title: NVIDIA Parakeet Riva ASR Deployment System
one_liner: Production-ready deployment of NVIDIA Parakeet RNNT via Riva ASR with WebSocket streaming and comprehensive infrastructure scripts.
what_it_is: A deployment framework and client wrapper for running NVIDIA's Parakeet RNNT automatic speech recognition model. It supports both modern NIM containers and traditional Riva server setups, providing low-latency streaming transcription via WebSocket with word-level timestamps and confidence scores.
how_its_built: Built with Python 3.10+ using FastAPI for the server interface, Pydantic for configuration management, and websockets for real-time audio streaming. It integrates with NVIDIA Riva ASR via gRPC clients, uses SpeechBrain for fallback or alternative modeling, and relies on Docker/NVIDIA Container Runtime for GPU-accelerated inference on Tesla T4/V100 instances.
how_to_apply: Deploy on AWS EC2 g4dn.xlarge or similar GPU instances. Use provided bash scripts to configure security groups, install NVIDIA drivers, deploy Riva/NIM containers, and start the WebSocket proxy. Connect client applications (browser or Node.js/Python) to the WebSocket endpoint for real-time transcription.
features: Real-time streaming transcription with ~100-300ms partial result latency
Dual deployment support for NVIDIA NIM containers and traditional Riva servers
Word-level timestamps and confidence scores for precise alignment
Production-grade structured logging and monitoring framework
WebSocket API for browser and application integration
Mock mode fallback for development without GPU hardware
